rules.name: Warband - Special Validation Rules
rules.description: Battlescribe will take into account the additional validation rules imposed by the 'High & Mighty' war band rule with 1 exception - it will allow you to take an additional Support AND Spellcaster while the rules state OR (so only 1 additional figure is allowed).  Please play fair and make sure you do not validate this rule.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Battle Fury (long)
sharedRules.description: Target an Engaged friendly model that is not Knocked-down. If any hits are scored, that model may immediately make a Melee action for free against any one model it is Engaged with, even if it is already Activated and/or Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: Spell - Might of the Tribes (long)
sharedRules.description: Target a friendly model, even if it is Engaged. That model may re-roll any failed Armour rolls until the end of the Round. In addition, the Crushing Strength and Piercing special rules are limited to (1) against this model until the end of the Round.

sharedRules.name: High & Mighty
sharedRules.description:
An Ogre Warband has no limit on the number of LARGE OGRE models it can include. In this warband, GRUNTS do count towards the minimum number of WARRIORS or GRUNTS, but do not count towards unlocks for SUPPORT, SPELLCASTER or
COMMAND models. An Ogre Warband may select one additional SUPPORT or SPELLCASTER model to the normal limit.

sharedRules.name: CACKLE! (1)
sharedRules.description: Use when the model activates. The model may cast the same spell twice this Turn if it has enough actions.

sharedRules.name: Ensnare
sharedRules.description: Models attempting to Break Away from this model must re-roll successfull Armour rolls.

sharedRules.name: DEFENSIVE SLAM (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability when the Ogre Sergeant attacks a model in Melee. That model cannot Retaliate against any Melee attacks made by the Ogre Sergeant this Turn.

sharedRules.name: TRIBAL DEFIANCE (2)
sharedRules.description: Use at any time during one of your activations. Until the end of the Round, all friendly OGRE models gain one free bonus die each time they make an Armour roll in response to a Melee or Ranged attack.

sharedRules.name: Intimidating
sharedRules.description: When subjected to a Melee attack or in base contact with an Objective, an OGRE model may choose one non-LARGE model that it is Engaging. That model is ignored for determining Outnumbering or who may claim the Objective.

sharedRules.name: HERE YOU GO BOSS (1)
sharedRules.description: Use at any time while this model is unactivated, standing, un-Engaged and within 3” of a friendly OGRE model. Spend the Power and mark the RED GOBLIN as Activated. The OGRE gains one of the following rules for the remainder of the current Turn: 6th Sense, Marksman, Vicious, Regeneration (5+).

sharedRules.name: Heavy Crossbow
sharedRules.description: A model which takes damage from a Ranged attack by this weapon is marked as Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: BOUNTY (2)
sharedRules.description: Once per game, spend the Power and take a long action to mark an enemy model within 12” and in Line of Sight with a Bounty token. For the remainder of the game all friendly OGRE models may add +1 die to any Melee attacks against enemy models with one or more Bounty Tokens.

sharedRules.name: Fanatical Acolytes
sharedRules.description: When casting a spell, this model may re-roll one die for each standing Berserker Brave or Berserker Bully within 6”.

sharedRules.name: Through the Legs
sharedRules.description: This model may ignore friendly OGRE models when determining if it has LOS to make a qualifying charge.

sharedRules.name: POINT BLANK (1)
sharedRules.description: Spend the Power before making a Melee attack against an enemy model. The Boomer Sergeant may use its Sawn-Off Ranged attack from the facing in which the enemy model is Engaged. Note that it cannot also gain a bonus die for a qualifying Charge. This counts as a Ranged attack.

sharedRules.name: BATTLE RAGE (2)
sharedRules.description: If this model can Engage an enemy model with a follow-up move, it may Engage that model and initiate another Melee by using the ability to go into a Battle Rage. This model will not get any bonus dice for charging however. Once this second Melee has been resolved, mark this model as Fatigued.

sharedRules.name: TRIBAL AUTHORITY (1)
sharedRules.description: Spend the Power at the start of an Activation by this model. This model may cast one Ogre Faction Special Spell during its Turn, as a normal cast action

sharedRules.name: SEIZE THE MOMENT (2)
sharedRules.description: Use this ability at the start of the Round, immediately after rolling for Power. The warband which finished the previous Round last, takes the first Turn this Round. Only useable once per game.

sharedRules.name: SIEGE MENTALITY (1)
sharedRules.description: Use at any time during this model’s Activation. For the remainder of the Round, while within 3” of the Siege Breaker, friendly models have the Dodge special rule.
